dedupe_keys.name: greenr urban greenness and heat analysis

description: greenR is the greenR developers' R package and Shiny application for analysing urban greenery, accessibility and planting priorities. It combines street networks, satellite observations, population grids, building geometry and canopy-height inputs. Outputs include street greenness scores, sky-view factors, access maps, spatial-inequality statistics and planting-priority maps. Spatial resolution and observation dates follow the selected inputs and analysis units. Source is free under GPL-3.0, with documented functions and examples; external data and routing services retain their own conditions. A limitation is that street-canyon and heat-priority indicators depend on input completeness and modelling choices and do not by themselves validate local thermal comfort. greenR can prepare green-infrastructure and urban-heat scenarios. OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap) and Meta/WRI canopy maps (data-meta-wri-global-canopy-height-1m) are documented input families. No imagery, network data or Shiny service was downloaded or deployed.
